name: ingest_uploads
description: Auto-index files dropped in Discord into the RAG database. Scans /data/uploads (or a given path/file), extracts text from .txt/.md/.json/code/.csv/.log and .pdf (via pypdf if available), and adds each to /data/rag_memory/rag.db with title=filename, source=path, tags. Keeps a ledger at /data/ingest_uploads/seen.json so the same file isn't indexed twice (action='scan' only does new ones; force=true re-indexes). Actions: scan, status, forget(path).
